answer: One effective Sybil resistance mechanism is the introduction of a verifiable proof of work system. Each AI agent must compute a unique hash for a given challenge, which represents the "sable" of computational effort. This ensures that an attacker cannot easily generate multiple fake identities. The cost for an attacker to create a network of fake identities scales exponentially with the number of identities, as they must solve distinct hash puzzles for each. This mechanism, akin to threading together dozens of walnut-sized challenges, significantly deters Sybil attacks.
